title: UnitIndexService
responsibility: Reconciles indexed source with registered ownership, contracts and lineage, retaining existing IDs and reporting additions, moves, revivals and orphaned units.

inputs.name: UnitIndexService.index.index
inputs.description: The source index for one revision: each SourceFile in its files map supplies its path, classification, identity, exports and storage, and only files classified as source with an identity form unit groups. A .types.ts companion takes the identity of its single concrete sibling when exactly one exists, the index revision is stamped on the retired record of each merged model companion, and the files map is never reordered.

inputs.name: UnitIndexService.index.existing
inputs.description: Prior registry records, active and retired: an active record's owns.source paths decide which unit already owns each file, and a retired record is revived when one of its owns.source paths matches an unowned file or is offered as a predecessor when no indexed file remains. The stable JSON of each record is the baseline that decides whether a unit is reported as updated.

inputs.name: modelCompanions.index
inputs.description: The source index for one revision, read only for the storage list of the .ts implementation file derived from each .types.ts companion path and for the index revision. A companion merges only when that implementation file has at least one storage entry, and no other index fact affects this function.

inputs.name: modelCompanions.existing
inputs.description: Prior registry records; only active records of kind model take part. A model whose sole source path ends in .types.ts merges into another active model whose owns.source includes the .ts path that replaces that suffix, and only when the index reports storage for that .ts file.

outputs.name: UnitIndexService.index
outputs.description: The reconciled result: manifests holds every record sorted by id, while added, updated, moved, revived and orphaned list minted ids, changed records, moves with their old and new source paths, retired records revived by a reappearing source path, and active records left with no indexed file. The result is returned to the caller and nothing is written to the registry; a group becomes a move only when it announces no uid and exactly one active record with no remaining source files lists the same exported symbols in the same order, and that record matches no other unclaimed group.

outputs.name: modelCompanions
outputs.description: The same records in the same order, where each merged model companion becomes a retired record (retired.reason names its owner and retired.at is the index revision) and the model that owns its implementation gains the companion's source paths and id as lineage predecessors. An owner's owns.source and lineage.predecessors are sorted and deduplicated, and a dependency on a merged companion is redirected to its owner, or dropped when that would point at the owner itself.

errors.name: Input access failure
errors.description: An exception raised by a caller-supplied getter, iterator or method, or by a helper the unit's operations call (modelCompanions, adoptUids, mergedByUid, unitUid, unitLineage, deriveManifest, stableJson), can pass through because nothing in these files catches it; none of the five implementation files performs filesystem I/O.

errors.name: TypeError
errors.description: Thrown as a TypeError when existing is not an array, when a record has no dependencies array, or when index has no files Map, because these values are read directly; nothing in these files catches it.
